integrity: An explicit all-horizon induction establishes the extremal counts and uniqueness, and a two-step graph establishes countability. Integer enumeration is supplementary and does not certify novelty or replace a proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact dyadic quarter-holes and doubling map only; arbitrary finite schedules, but infinite-survivor classification only for constant/alternating schedules. Existing fixed-hole symbolic and negative-doubling methods may contain equivalent special-case counts; priority of the all-schedule optimization remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp finite-time switching bounds for two quarter-interval holes of the doubling map
